title: Northern Ireland grocers not in the GEOLYTIX data, from the FSA food hygiene register
coverage: Northern Ireland: 11 councils (supplementary to GEOLYTIX; not in any store count or rate)
attribution: Food Standards Agency food hygiene rating data, Northern Ireland councils, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0

retrieval.method: FSA open data XML per council (fetch-reference), cached in pipeline/raw/fsa/
retrieval.notes: Kept: grocery symbol groups GEOLYTIX does not carry in NI (by name), and independent grocers registered as supermarkets/hypermarkets that are not within 50 m of a mapped store. Chains GEOLYTIX maps are left to it. Same group or name at the same postcode = one shop. Rules: pipeline/foodscope_pipeline/config/ni_grocers.json; every decision in the QA report.
